title: Make Interfere your own
summary: Every agent on the platform is continuously optimized to get faster, more accurate and cheaper with every run. Now your own agents can steer that process, from how problems are titled and assigned to how they’re resolved.
body_markdown:
Every agent on Interfere is continuously optimized to get faster, more accurate and cheaper with every run. We’ve expanded the[Interfere MCP](https://interfere.com/changelog/mcp-cli-sdk) so your own agents can steer that process and shape Interfere around how your team works.


Not happy with how a problem was titled or auto-assigned? Your agent can leave feedback on almost every part of the problem lifecycle, from titles and assignees to investigations, and Interfere takes it into account on the next run. If Interfere misses that a fix has shipped, your agent can mark the problem as in recovery and point to the release that fixed it.


If Interfere misses a bug entirely, you can report it from the inbox or have your agent send it through the MCP. Each report kicks off an automated process in the background to work out why it was missed, and goes straight to our engineering team.


Your agent can also ask about the users behind a problem. It can look up a user by email or ID, see their active problems, most recent error and recent sessions, and step through a replay of what they were doing.


With our Platform SDK,[@interfere/javascript](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@interfere/javascript) , you can build your own automations on top of Interfere, so it notifies you about exactly what you care about, in the language and level of detail you want.


Add` https://mcp.interfere.com/mcp` to your agent to get started.
